datasheet: XINGLIGHT XL-1005UGC / XL-1005UBC technical data sheets p7 'Outline Dimension' [https://www.lcsc.com/datasheet/C965793.pdf, https://www.lcsc.com/datasheet/C22355736.pdf]: body 1.0 x 0.5 x 0.40; Recommended Soldering Pattern 0.3 x 0.55 lands, 0.5 gap, 0.8 between centres; polarity: pad 1 = cathode (-), pad 2 = anode (+); both data sheets identical
derivation: XINGLIGHT XL-1005UGC / XL-1005UBC 0402 LED (body 1.0 x 0.5 x 0.40, datasheet p7 'Outline Dimension' and 'Recommended Soldering Pattern' 0.3 x 0.55 lands, 0.5 gap, 0.8 centres; pad 1 cathode). IPC-7351C least density (D109): the maker land is already at the toe limit (outer edge 0.55 = body end + 0.05, = L max with the +-0.10 general tolerance), kept; width 0.55 -> 0.48 (body 0.50, side -0.01) so the courtyard is set by the body: 1.30 x 0.70.
